lines.trans: I want to say something important.
Did you kiss her?
No, I have not kissed her yet.
Do not worry, Lyova.
You took her to the movies five times and did not kiss her?
Did she come to Moscow to watch movies?
I do not know how it is customary in your country to court girls.
In your country you first have to ask the parents for permission.
But that is back home, and here is another country.
Here with you anything is allowed.
So, yes, I heard everything.

examples.trans: Dad, did you bring any gum?
I grew up in a communal flat.
Hello! How was it in Hungary?

examples.text: Я тебе утром говорил: не торопись. Это очень важный вопрос.
examples.trans: I told you this morning: don't rush. It's a very important question.

meanings.en: to drive (a vehicle), to know how to drive

meanings.note: водить мужиков = to bring men home

examples.trans: She drives a car very well.

examples.text: Если тебе плевать на дочь, то мне нет! Ты водишь.
examples.trans: If you don't care about our daughter, I do! You're driving.

examples.text: Решается ваш вопрос, Клавдия Викторовна! Вы не видите, у меня встреча?
examples.trans: Your question is being sorted out, Klavdia Viktorovna! Can't you see I have a meeting?

meanings.note: polite to one person, or to several people

meanings.en: other forms: вас (gen/acc), вам (dat), вами (instr), вас (prep)

examples.text: Спасибо, спасибо! Как вы все знаете, я родился и вырос в Синеозерске.
examples.trans: Thank you, thank you! As you all know, I was born and grew up in Sineozersk.

meanings.note: emphatic at the start of a sentence

examples.text: У мужчины, мальчик, бывает не только жена. Это моя девушка.
examples.trans: A man, my boy, can have more than just a wife. She's my girlfriend.

related.gloss: to reach, walk as far as

examples.text: Послушайте, а можно в другое место? Здесь плохо пахнет.
examples.trans: Listen, could we go somewhere else? It smells bad in here.

meanings.note: in threats: ты ещё увидишь = you'll see

examples.text: У тебя же есть ещё. Дай хоть одну.
examples.trans: But you've still got some. Give me just one.

meanings.note: adds emphasis to the word before it

examples.text: У тебя же есть ещё. Дай хоть одну.
examples.trans: But you've still got some. Give me just one.

examples.text: Спасибо, спасибо! Как вы все знаете, я родился и вырос в Синеозерске.
examples.trans: Thank you, thank you! As you all know, I was born and grew up in Sineozersk.

meanings.note: verb: Что это значит? = What does it mean?
emphasis: вот поэтому ты и... = that's exactly why you...

examples.trans: I was born and grew up here.

examples.text: Спасибо, спасибо! Как вы все знаете, я родился и вырос в Синеозерске.
examples.trans: Thank you, thank you! As you all know, I was born and grew up in Sineozersk.

meanings.note: Как вы знаете = as you know.

examples.trans: Hello! How was it in Hungary?
Then invite me to the movies.
So, let's look at the schedule in the cinema.

examples.text: Зачем ты вообще ведёшь её в кино?
examples.trans: Why are you even taking her to the movies?
Can I go and have a look?

meanings.note: нас = us (gen/acc/prep); у нас = we have, at our place

meanings.en: other forms: нас (gen/acc), нам (dat), нами (instr), нас (prep)

examples.text: Смотрите, какой у нас грязный унитаз!
examples.trans: Look, how dirty our toilet is!

meanings.en: must, need to, it is necessary

examples.trans: We need to do even more.

meanings.note: goes right before the word it negates
+ genitive: 'у нас нет выбора' = we have no choice

examples.text: Мы сделали много, но надо ещё.
examples.trans: We've done a lot, but we need more.
I want to, but I can't.

examples.text: Мы сделали много, но надо сделать ещё больше.
examples.trans: We've done a lot, but we need to do even more.

examples.text: Она нашла нас на новом месте.
examples.trans: She found us at the new place.
That is it, she got really offended.
She is not answering her phone.

переживать.gloss: to worry, to fret; to go through

examples.trans: Why are you worrying like that?
Don't worry, everything will be fine.

examples.text: Что вы так переживаете? Самсонов всё, он себя закопал.
examples.trans: Why are you worrying like that? Samsonov is finished, he buried himself.
Which car did you come in?

examples.text: Вика, ты на какой машине сегодня приехала?
examples.trans: Vika, which car did you come in today?

meanings.note: у нас принято = it's customary here

examples.trans: OK, deal, your condition is accepted.

examples.text: У нас принято ходить в юбках.
examples.trans: Here it's customary to wear skirts.

meanings.note: просить прощения = to ask for forgiveness

examples.text: Когда вырасту, ты будешь просить у меня прощения!
examples.trans: When I grow up, you'll be begging me to forgive you!

examples.text: Мы же только начинаем. Через месяц будет пять тысяч.
examples.trans: But we're only just starting. In a month there'll be five thousand.

examples.text: У меня есть официальное разрешение на снос.
examples.trans: I have official permission for demolition.

examples.text: Кто посмел принять тебя без моего разрешения?
examples.trans: Who dared hire you without my permission?
Just please don't tell my parents.
My parents live in the country.

examples.text: Возьмите свои работы и подарите родителям.
examples.trans: Take your work and give it to your parents.

meanings.note: once; что скажешь? = what do you say?

examples.trans: Tell us, when will your programme be out?

examples.text: Как странно, я ничего об этом не слышал.
examples.trans: How strange, I've heard nothing about it.

examples.text: Привет! Смотри, что у меня есть.

meanings.en: to be able to, to manage to

examples.trans: We came as soon as we could.
Will you be able to come tomorrow morning?

examples.text: Я думаю, что у меня есть мужчина. Он сможет меня защитить.
examples.trans: I think that I have a man. He will be able to protect me.
First they were rude and insulting over there.
Let's start everything from the beginning.

examples.text: Мы танцевали. Сначала они там грубили, оскорбляли.
examples.trans: We were dancing. First they were rude and insulting over there.
The whole country is laughing at you!

examples.text: Над тобой вся страна смеётся! Все видели, как ты из окна летел.
examples.trans: The whole country is laughing at you! Everyone saw you fly out the window.
There's someone here to see you.

examples.text: Аркадий Борисович, извините, тут к вам человек.
examples.trans: Arkady Borisovich, I'm sorry, there's a man here to see you.

meanings.en: other forms: тебя (gen/acc), тебе (dat), тобой (instr), тебе (prep)

examples.trans: Dad, did you bring any gum?

examples.text: Привет! Смотри, что у меня есть.
Я не удержалась и купила пёсика.
examples.trans: I could not resist and bought a puppy.

examples.text: Я просто не удержалась и купила этого милого пёсика.
examples.trans: I simply could not resist and bought this cute little dog.

examples.text: Трудно удержаться от улыбки, когда Луи начинает петь.
examples.trans: It is hard to hold back a smile when Louis starts singing.

ухаживать.gloss: to court, to woo; to look after

meanings.en: to court, to pay court to
to look after, to care for

examples.text: Он за мной после концерта ухаживал.
examples.trans: He courted me after a concert once.
She looks after her sick mother.

examples.text: Он за мной после концерта ухаживал. В Москву звал замуж!
examples.trans: He courted me after a concert once. He asked me to marry him and come to Moscow!
If you don't want to, suit yourself.
They want to build a shopping centre there.

meanings.note: целую! = kisses! (at the end of a call or message)

examples.trans: Well, call me, kitten. Bye, kisses!

meanings.note: instrumental чем-то: чем-то помочь = help with something

examples.text: Так может быть, тебе надо чем-то помочь?
examples.trans: So maybe you need help with something?

meanings.note: pointing at a thing or a situation; 'это' + noun = 'this is ...'
points at something: это моё = that's mine

meanings.en: other forms: этого, этому, это, этим, этом

examples.trans: And this is for you. A toy car!

meanings.en: other forms: меня (gen/acc), мне (dat), мной (instr), мне (prep)
